subject: RFP: Support & TAM coverage — succession, escalation and incident communications

Subject: RFP: Support & TAM coverage — Redwood Inference

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for your time last week. As part of our vendor selection for inference infrastructure, were collecting detailed support/TAM coverage information to include in the SOW appendix. Attached is our canonical worksheet — could you confirm Redwood's answers for the sections below by EOD next Tuesday (21 Sep)? Key areas we need covered: TAM roster and escalation chain, on-call hours and handoff, notification templates for Sev1/Sev2 incidents, backup support responsibilities across Dedicated vs Private deployments, and audit log retention for incident timelines.

Anita

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Support & TAM coverage — Redwood Inference

Hi Anita —

Appreciate the questionnaire. Well populate the worksheet and return a consolidated PDF with our TAM roster and incident templates by 21 Sep. High-level notes up front:
- Redwood provides 24/7 platform incident monitoring for Hosted and Dedicated tiers; TAM coverage (named CSM/TAM team) is available business-hours by default and can be extended to 24/7 for Dedicated/Private via a premium support add-on.
- Standard SLA for Sev1 notification: initial ack within 15 minutes; customer-facing incident update cadence every 60 minutes until resolution.
- Audit/event logs retained 180 days by default for Hosted, configurable up to 3 years for Private deployments (via customer-managed storage policies).

Well attach the roster CSV and a draft incident notification template for your legal/ops review. If you have a preferred format for the answers, let me know; otherwise well mirror the spreadsheet columns.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.ai)
Attachment: rki-answers-v1.pdf (draft answers)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Support & TAM coverage — Redwood Inference

Rachel / Ben —

Quick review of rki-answers-v1.pdf and some suggested clarifications before we send to Anita:
1) TAM coverage phrasing: avoid implying TAM performs platform-level remediation for Hosted (ops does that). Suggest: "TAM provides technical account guidance, runbook alignment, and escalation coordination; platform remediation is executed by Redwood Incident Response (ops) for Hosted deployments."
2) 24/7 TAM: we should call out cost center and lead time (30 days) for onboarding a 24/7 TAM rotation.
3) Escalation chain: include names for primary/secondary TAMs in roster but redact personal emails in the public SOW appendix; provide a separate secure roster CSV.
4) Incident notifications: our standard template already matches Globexs Sev1 cadence, but add the optional SLA credit language only if procurement requests it.

Also flagging one procurement ask: they want explicit RTO/RPO language for Private on-prem backups. We should confirm with Product what the standard RTO commitment is (I think 4 hours for node-replacement in dedicated managed infra, no formal RTO for air-gapped private unless contracted).

If these changes look good I can update the spreadsheet and produce the final PDF.

—Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Support & TAM coverage — Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — I agree with edits. A couple of policy items from CS leadership:
- For public SOWs we provide redacted roster + named primary TAM by role/title. Full roster (names, cell, escalation order) goes via secure link/attachment under NDA.
- 24/7 TAM is offered as a paid add-on with a single point price for coverage per seat + hourly emergency engineering. Standard onboarding SLA for additional TAM seats: 30 calendar days.
- Regarding RTO/RPO language: we can commit an operational target (example: 4h node replacement) for Dedicated managed infra. For Private/on-prem we will provide recommended runbooks; contractual RTO requires a bespoke appendix — recommend we mark as "to be negotiated" in the public questionnaire and offer a follow-up workshop.

Once Karthik updates the spreadsheet, I will sign off and attach the secure roster CSV and final PDF.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Hi Anita —

Please find attached our completed questionnaire for Globex. Key highlights:
- TAM coverage: Redwood will assign a named Primary TAM (role/title) and provide a secure roster CSV with full escalation order under NDA. Default TAM coverage is 8x5 business hours; 24/7 TAM available as an add-on (30-day onboarding).
- Incident communications: initial ack for Sev1 within 15 minutes; hourly customer updates; templated notifications attached.
- Audit logs and retention: Hosted platform retains operational logs 180 days by default; Private deployments support configurable retention up to 3 years (customer-managed).
- RTO/RPO: We propose 4-hour operational target for node recovery in Dedicated managed infra; Private/on-prem RTO to be negotiated in appendix.

Attachments: Redwood_Globex_Support_Questionnaire_20260921.pdf (final answers), redwood-tam-roster.csv (secure copy — provided under separate secure link), DocuSign envelopeId=0a1b2c3d4e for standard SOW exhibit.
